champions.d:
Adaptor AD: Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing 145/220/380% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage. If the target is Burning, deal an additional 35/52/80% AD damage.
Adaptor AP: If the Ability kills, cast it again.
Slice the target for 160/240/410% AD + 10/15/25 AP physical damage and gain 60/90/200 Shield for 2 seconds.

Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of 310/465/700% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage and applying 20% Wound and 1% Burn for 4 seconds.
Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains 22% Attack Damage each cast.

Tether the current target, dealing 280/420/630 AP magic damage over 1.5 seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing 120/180/270 AP magic damage to all enemies in a 1 hex radius and 30% Slowing them for 2 seconds.
Restore 265/315/460 AP + 7% max Health over 2 seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals 10% max Health + 70/105/150 AP magic damage.

Passive: Start combat with 60/80/100 AP bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over 12 seconds.
Active: Bash the current target, dealing 150/270/405% Armor magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

Active: Gain 400/460/550 AP Shield for 4 seconds and deal 200/300/450 AP magic damage to enemies in a cone.
Quest: Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power.

Begin consuming 35% max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal 160/240/360 AP magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by 3.
Teal Buff: Gain 2 Mana Regen for every 4 seconds channeled.
Gain 270/320/415 AP Shield for 4 seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

Passive: Restore 10/14/20 Health each second, tripled for 3 seconds after casting.
Active: Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for 1 second and dealing 70/105/160 AP magic damage to them.

Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals 415/625/1000% AD + 30/45/70 AP physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by 40% for each enemy it passes through (minimum 40%).

Launch a giant blast at the target that deals 175/265/395 AP magic damage, increased to 265/400/595 AP if they're below 30% max Health.
If they die, permanently gain 3% Ability Power.
Gain 50% Attack Speed for the next 5 attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal 68/102/155% AD physical damage and reduce Armor by 2 AP.

Passive: On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with 200/400/750 + 20% max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.
Active: Restore 280/325/435 AP Health and strike the target, dealing 150/225/340 AP physical damage.

Roar, restoring 8% max Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for 80/105/130 AP. Then slam the current target, dealing 100/150/225 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
Passive: Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals 190/285/470% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage.

Transform into a spider and gain 375/475/725 max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal 35/50/80 AP bonus magic damage and heal for 55/90/170 AP. Subsequent casts grant 175% decaying Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

Adaptor AP: Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225/340/535 AP magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius take 160/240/360 AP magic damage over 3 seconds.
Adaptor AD: Heavily slows the target.
Purple Buff: Every 5 seconds, Gromp gains 30% Ability Power.

Passive: Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting stacking bonuses.
1st Ascension: Attacks deal 62/92/105 AP bonus magic damage.
2nd: Attacks 20% Shred enemies hit for 2 seconds.
3rd: Attacks fire waves, dealing 35 AP magic damage to all other units hit.
4th: Gain infinite range. Every 3rd wave is much larger.

Passive: After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a 10/15/40% chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by 4% per takedown.
Active: Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing 260/390/615 AP magic damage and 100/150/230 AP to adjacent enemies.

Leap to the lowest Health enemy within 3 hexes and deal 100/150/225% AD + 20/30/45 AP physical damage. The next 2 attacks gain 175% Attack Speed and deal 60/90/135% AD bonus physical damage.
Grey Buff: Gain Precision and 25% Critical Strike Chance, increased up to 75% based on missing Health.

Passive: Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals 50/75/112.5% AD physical damage to all adjacent enemies.
Active: Burrow underground, gaining 15% Durability for 3 seconds and healing 325/400/675 AP over the duration.
Green Buff: When allies fall below 50% Health, they restore 15% max Health.
Gain 225/250/275 AP + 10% max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing 90/135/205 AP magic damage and strike in a line, dealing 120/180/270 AP magic damage to enemies hit.
Grant 350/430/550 AP Shield to Shen and 200/275/375 AP Shield to a nearby damaged ally for 4 seconds. Both of their next 3 attacks gain 40% Attack Speed and deal 35/55/80 AP bonus magic damage.

Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal 60/90/135 AP magic damage to the 3 nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals 135/200/310 AP magic damage to the target.
Each cast has a 10/12/15% chance to forage an extra mushroom. Red: 1 reroll. Green: 1 Tactician Health. Yellow: 2 XP.
Bite the current target, dealing 215/325/500% AD physical damage and healing for 20% AP of the damage dealt. Gain 20% Attack Speed for the rest of combat.
Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals 160/240/370% AD physical damage and splits, dealing 35% of that to 2 nearby enemies.
Gain 150% Attack Speed and summon 2 soldiers for the next 6 attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal 43/65/103 AP magic damage per attack.
Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing 400/600/950 AP magic damage over 15 seconds. Poisons stack.
Gain 150/275/500 shield for 2 seconds and send out 6 moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing 75/115/180 AP magic damage.
Reduce the Magic Resist of the 3 nearest enemies by 10. Then drain life from them over 2 seconds, healing for 410/485/850 AP Health and dealing 70/105/170 AP magic damage to each over the duration.

Gain 50 Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore 375/475/685 AP Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 80/120/195 AP magic damage and Stunning them for 1.5/1.5/1.75 seconds.
Leap to the farthest enemy within 3 hexes, dealing 285/400/580 AP magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal 310/445/660 AP magic damage instead and gain 10 mana.

Adaptor AD: Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing 145/220/375% AD + 20/30/50 AP physical damage. Enemies below 50% max Health take 140% of that instead.
Adaptor AP: Damages enemies over time.

Passive: On death, split into two Kruglettes with 50/100/180 + 12% max Health which immediately taunt.
Active: Gain 175/225/325 AP max Health, then roll into the target, dealing 135/200/335% AD + 8% max Health damage.
Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for 8% max Health.

Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for 5 AP seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing 22/33/48% AD physical damage.
Orange Buff: Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by 2.

Passive: Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.
Adaptor AD: Double Strikes grant 12% + 3% AP stacking Attack Speed.
Adaptor AP: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.

Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For 4 seconds, gain 350/450/550 AP Shield and 60 Armor and Magic Resist.
When the Shield breaks, deal 50/75/120% Armor + 50/75/120% MR physical damage to enemies in 2 hexes.
Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within 3 hexes and stab them, dealing 255/385/615% AD physical damage. Then heal for 60/90/90 AP, increased up to 120/180/180 AP based on their missing Health.

Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts 4 seconds. While active, gain infinite range and 40% + 20% AP Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing 160/240/385% AD physical damage + 10/15/25% AD for each attack while casting.

Passive: On attack, restore 2% max Health.
Active: Unleash a primal roar, restoring 200/265/360 AP Health. Then gain 85/100/125% Attack Speed, 15% Durability, and become Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

Launch a spirit bomb at the location within 4 hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals 455/685/3500 AP magic damage to enemies in a 3 hex radius, reduced by 21% per hex away from the epicenter.

Passive: Every second, restore 2.5/2.5/4% + 20/25/100 AP Health and deal 12/18/150 AP magic damage to enemies within 1 hex.
Active: Deal 100/150/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for 1/1/6 seconds, increased if the target is Burning.

Equip Severum and swipe the target 5 times over 2 seconds, each dealing 70/105/850% AD physical damage.
After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals 450/675/5000% AD + 40/60/225 AP physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 hex radius.

Passive: When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing 155/235/1000% AD physical damage.
Active: Gain 80/80/300% Attack Damage for 8 seconds. During this time ignore 15% Armor.
Red Buff: Attacks 1% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for 4% max Health.

Blink away from the current target, deal 250/375/1200% AD physical damage to them, and gain 30/30/100% AP Attack Speed.
Every 4th cast consumes that Attack Speed and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies, dealing 385/580/2500% AD physical damage, reduced by 25% per enemy passed through (minimum 50%).

Restore 325/475/800 AP Health and send 4 butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take 90/135/2000 AP magic damage and Sleep for 1.5/1.75/8 seconds. If they take 1000 damage, they wake up and take an additional 10% max Health magic damage.

Gain 700/850/2000 AP Shield for 4 seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing 30/45/999% MR + 30/45/999% Armor + 40/60/2000 AP magic damage to enemies within 2/2/3 hexes.

Passive: Gain 25% Omnivamp.
Active: Fire a dark blast at 3 nearby enemies, dealing 60/90/500 AP magic damage and cursing them for 4 seconds. Then spawn a 2 hex withering zone for the same duration that deals 33/50/500 AP magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take 22/33/240 AP more damage per curse.

Adaptor AP: Gain 150% Attack Speed for the next 3 attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal 170/255/2000 AP magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals 300/450/3000 AP magic damage.
Adaptor AD: Transform into a melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.

Gain 350/450/2000 AP + 10% max Health Shield for 4 seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take 100/150/3500 AP magic damage, and are Mana Reaved for 10.
Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain 2 Mana Regen.

Passive: Upon falling below 40% max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.
Active: Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for 12% + 225/275/2000 AP before dealing 150/225/5000% AD + 6% max Health physical damage in a large cone.

Throw a large crossblade that deals 190/285/1050% AD + 15/20/100 AP physical damage to the current target and bounces 8 times between nearby enemies, dealing 20/20/40% of that each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce 3/3/6 additional times.
Call down a star on the current target, dealing 225/335/1000 AP magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down 3 additional stars that each deal 100/150/1000 AP magic damage.
Spawn 2/2/4 plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy 10 times. Each attack deals 35/53/225 AP magic damage.

Rain 9 moonshards split among the 3 nearest enemies, dealing 55/83/500 AP magic damage each.
If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing 2350/3600/7500 AP magic damage split among all enemies.

Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals 465/700/1000% AD physical damage, reduced by 80/80/40% per enemy hit (minimum 20%).
The arrow leaves a trail for 4/4/20 seconds that deals 5/8/200% AD + 2/3/10% max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and 20% Slows them.

Passive: Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed dealing 140/210/3000% AD physical damage over 12 seconds. Every attack has a 12% AP chance to deal 50/50/900% bonus physical damage and apply 2 bleeds instead.
Active: Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds, dealing 100/150/400% AD physical damage and consuming their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes return, dealing 30/45/100% AD physical damage.

Passive: Attacks deal 75/75/100% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.
Active: Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for 1.25/1.25/99 seconds, gain 15/15/100% Omnivamp, and Ignite them. Ignited enemies take 2/2/20% max Health physical damage per second.
Flame Breath: Spew fire in a line, dealing 285/435/7000% AD + 20/30/200 AP physical damage.
Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below 12% Health executes them.

Passive: Gain 5/5/50 Rage per second and 5/5/20 Rage per attack.
Active: Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within 3 hexes, dealing 100/150/2000% AD physical damage, reducing Armor and Magic Resist by 15/20/250 AP, and Stunning for 1/1/15 second. Mega Gnar gains 400/600/15000 Health.
Grab n' Throw: Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing 380/570/9000% AD physical damage.

Passive: Shields from this Ability can critically strike with Precision.
Active: Grant 2/2/10 allies 185/350/3000 AP Shield and 10/15/100% Damage Amp for 6 seconds. Then deal 155/235/2000 AP magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting 6 times, also grant 100% stacking Attack Speed to targets.

Charge up, gaining 15% Ability Power per Burning enemy. Then gain 250/350/3000 AP Shield for 2.5 seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing 80/120/1500 AP magic damage to each.
After rushing, unleash a 2 hex firestorm dealing a total of 475/715/5000 AP magic damage split among all enemies hit over 2 seconds.

Passive: On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain 3/3/100 AP mana.
Active: Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals 375/565/6500 AP magic damage, reduced by 25/25/10% for each enemy hit.
The chosen Avatar origin adds a bonus effect and counts twice toward that trait.

Passive: After every 650/650/300 damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals 7/7/75% max Health magic damage. On death, 3/5/10 saplings jump out.
Active: Deal 6/6/100% max Health magic damage to target and restore 330/400/2000 AP + 10/10/100% missing Health.

Passive: The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below 50% Health, unleash emerald energy from both, granting 100/225/10000 + 15/15/100% max Health Shield to allies within 3 hexes.
Active: Restore 250/375/3000 AP Health. Taric and his paired ally deal 100/150/1000 AP bonus magic damage on their next 2 attacks.
